function.name: escalateToHuman
function.description: Escalate the call to a human agent with FULL structured context (warm handoff). Call immediately when: the caller asks for a person, the same question fails twice, the caller is frustrated, it is a dental emergency, or the request is out of scope. Fill every parameter you have information for — the human must not need to ask the caller to repeat anything.

callerName.description: Caller's name, if collected. Empty string if unknown.

existingPatient.description: Whether the caller is an existing patient, if known.

intent.description: What the caller was trying to do.

escalationReason.description: Why the call is being escalated.

urgency.description: How urgently a human must call back.

reasonForVisit.description: Reason for visit collected so far, even partial.

preferredDate.description: Preferred date collected so far, if any.

insurance.description: Insurance info collected so far, if any.

noMatchCount.description: How many failed understanding attempts occurred. 0 if none.

questionsAsked.description: The questions you asked the caller during this call.

transcriptSummary.description: 1-3 sentence summary of the call written FOR THE HUMAN AGENT: what the caller wanted, what was collected, what went wrong.
